# Topic audit coverage

**Generated by `scripts/build-topic-audit-index.js`. Do not edit by hand.**
Rebuild it with `npm run build:audit-index`; the offline suite fails on drift.

For what is due *this week*, run `node scripts/check-audit-freshness.js`.
That view depends on today's date, so it is deliberately not baked in here:
a generated file carrying it would drift at every midnight.

One row per topic on the schedule. A row is **Fresh** only when an audit record
exists and nothing in that topic has changed since the audit date, so a topic
audited in September and revised in October reads as Stale rather than done.

Dates are the school's own, in Indiana time. This page is a view, not a
state file: every value on it is derived at build time from the audit records
in this folder, the schedule, and git history.

## Is the weekly sweep alive?

**No sweep marker exists yet.** The weekly sweep writes one every time it
runs, including on a week with nothing scheduled, so a missing marker means
the automation did not run, never that there was nothing to do.

`scripts/check-audit-freshness.js` is what fails when that marker goes stale.
It runs nightly rather than in the push gate, because an overdue audit must
never be the thing standing between a broken classroom page and a fix.
